verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party description of a portfolio, dashboard or roll-up view that aggregates progress across multiple projects. What it does have is adjacent: API primitives for creating views at any level of the hierarchy, a suggested use case where an external AI assistant connected through MCP drafts 'portfolio summaries', and a third-party analytics integration. Under the partial-credit rules, developer building blocks, AI-generated text summaries and third-party tools do not count as a native portfolio progress view.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can roll up progress across multiple projects into a single portfolio view
